def test_solution():
    # Basic cases: odd elements at even indices
    assert solution([1, 2, 3]) == 1          # idx 0: 1 (odd, counted), idx 2: 3 (odd, counted)
    assert solution([3, 3, 3, 3, 3]) == 9    # idx 0, 2, 4 -> 3+3+3
    assert solution([0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]) == 0 # even values at even indices
    assert solution([5, 0, 5, 0, 5]) == 15   # odd values at even indices
    assert solution([1, 1, 1, 1]) == 2       # idx 0 and 2 -> 1+1

    # Odd values at odd indices should not be counted
    assert solution([2, 1, 2, 1, 2]) == 0    # odd values only at odd indices

    # Empty list
    assert solution([]) == 0

    # Single element list
    assert solution([1]) == 1
    assert solution([2]) == 0
    assert solution([0]) == 0

    # Negative numbers
    assert solution([-1, 2, -3]) == -4       # -1 and -3 are odd, at even indices
    assert solution([-2, -1, -4, -3]) == 0   # no odd values at even indices

    # Larger list
    assert solution(list(range(10))) == 1 + 5 + 9  # idx 0,2,4,6,8 -> 1+5+9
    assert solution([7] * 6) == 21                 # idx 0,2,4 -> 7*3

    # Mixed values
    assert solution([1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9]) == 17  # idx 0:1, idx 4:7, idx 6:9

    print("All tests passed!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_solution()
